name: Wading birds
description: Herons, egrets, ibises and wood storks. Functional group pooling six source compartments: egrets, great blue heron, other herons, wood stork, white ibis and the remaining pelican-like waterbirds, aggregated because all hunt in the marsh shallows. Heavy consumers of crayfish, prawns and other aquatic invertebrates; they also take snakes and are raided by alligators.
